# CANDIDATE: ATR_CONTRACTION_BREAKOUT_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After a period of low volatility (ATR contraction), a break below the prior low on elevated volume often triggers a short‑term continuation to the downside. This edge exists because volatility contraction precedes expansion, and volume‑confirmed breaks below multi-bar lows indicate institutional selling pressure that tends to persist for at least one bar.

## Mechanism

Entry: When ATR(10) < 0.5 * ATR(20) for three consecutive bars AND price closes below the lowest low of the prior 20 bars AND volume of that bar > 1.5 * average volume of the prior 20 bars, enter short at the next bar's open.  
Exit: Chart‑stop at the most recent swing high (structure invalidation), TP1 at 1.8R, runner trail 12% off high‑water mark.  
Regime filters: Only trade when VIX > 16 and between 11:00‑14:00 EST; avoid 12:00‑13:00 EST unless volume remains >1.3x average volume of prior 20 bars.
